acceptance_criteria: A visible 'New note' control exists on the main page.
Submitting non-empty text adds a note to the visible list without a full page reload.
The new note's text is displayed verbatim in the list.
test_steps: Navigate to the app root URL.
Click the 'New note' control and type 'hello world'.
Assert a list item containing exactly 'hello world' is visible and no full navigation occurred.
